title: The Personal University of Self-Development: Maximizing the Advantage in the World to Come
summary: Invoking Doctrine and Covenants 130:18–19, President Hughes challenges missionaries to treat their pandemic lockdown as a personal university for lifelong self-improvement. He outlines four key benefits of personal development—stepping out of comfort zones, amplifying strengths, boosting confidence, and raising self-awareness—alongside a structured six-step execution plan. To channel their agency effectively, he provides five concrete daily goals, including studying English, performing dual daily workouts, engaging ward members via active listening video chats, and memorizing Dale Carnegie's human relations principles.
